name: infobip
description: Research, send, and track performance with Infobip.

interface.longDescription: Get guidance on customer messaging implementation choices and best practices, including requirements by country and channel. Send with Infobip, then track trends in volume, delivery, costs, errors, and engagement metrics.
defaultPrompt: Send an SMS to [recipient] with this message: [message].
Use Infobip to research requirements for sending [channel] messages in [country].
Compare [channels] performance over [time period], including volume, delivery, and available engagement.
